CFG.API_KEY_DESC: Key of your YouGile account. Get one with the helper script or POST /api-v2/auth/keys (see the README).
CFG.TASK_URL_DESC: Link opened from a task. Placeholders: {host}, {id}, {idTaskCommon}, {idTaskProject}.
CFG.IS_SHOW_TIME_TRACKING_DIALOG: Log time to YouGile when a task is done
CFG.IS_SHOW_TIME_TRACKING_DIALOG_DESC: Shows a dialog that adds the time you tracked to the task's time tracking in YouGile.
CFG.IS_SHOW_TIME_TRACKING_DIALOG_FOR_EACH_SU: Show the dialog for each subtask
CFG.DEFAULT_TIME_ALL_TIME_MINUS_LOGGED: All tracked time minus already logged

FORM_HELP: Imports YouGile tasks assigned to you and keeps them in sync: done state, title, deadline and time estimate in both directions, the description from YouGile. See SuperGile on GitHub.
